blockers.title: Stage B UI completion, standalone builds and manual runtime QA are storage-blocked
blockers.dependency: safe storage above the 10,485,760 KiB floor for the complete bounded run and exclusive Xcode ownership
evidence: resume preflight passed at 14,237,720 and 14,245,296 KiB with no conflicting process
complete non-live unit target passed 672 tests with zero failures/skips in 177.6 seconds; only the two authorized live-provider methods were excluded
unit run fell to 8,801,544 KiB; closed log/result and the one task DerivedData directory were removed, while prepared products were temporarily retained
APFS settled at 13,127,516 and 13,120,660 KiB before UI test-without-building
six critical-path UI tests passed; the seventh was in progress when the tool timed out at 300 seconds and free space fell to 6,532,376 KiB
the confirmed task-owned runner/xcodebuild were stopped; incomplete artifacts and prepared products were removed after handle checks
final cleanup reading was 11,052,360 KiB, below the 12,582,912 KiB restart threshold
standalone Debug/Release builds and manual runtime QA were not run
blockers.acceptance_criterion: Focused and practical complete non-live tests, Debug/Release builds and the critical/error paths pass on the authorized iPhone 17 Pro Simulator with bounded DerivedData.

blockers.title: Embedded SDK privacy manifests and signatures are uninspected

deep Debug signature verification passed
standalone Release app and combined Xcode privacy report remain uninspected
blockers.acceptance_criterion: Selected build's app/framework manifests, required-reason APIs, signatures and combined privacy report are inspected and reconciled.
